description:
One variable in full: names, unit, which dataset, its coverage, how its
    quality flag is read, licence and DOI.  For a multi-dimensional variable
    read through zarr (access 'zarr'), its axes with their labels, the slice
    /query serves (prescribed) and an xarray line for any other slice.
name: describe_variable

access.description: query: estimate/get_data/aggregate serve it; zarr: a multi-dimensional variable (e.g. the ONEFlux NEE cube) read with xarray -- see zarr_recipe, and `prescribed` for its /query slice
access.title: Access

axes.description: zarr variables: each extra axis and its labels
axes.title: Axes

prescribed.description: zarr variables: the id of the preferred slice /query serves
prescribed.title: Prescribed

quality_control.description: how the store's QC flag is read; apply_qc=true applies the recommended rule
quality_control.title: Quality Control

query_kind.description: station_time (series at stations), obs_table (ship/cruise observations) or grid (gridded product)
query_kind.title: Query Kind

variants.description: the multi-dimensional variables this one is the PRESCRIBED slice of; their other slices are read through zarr (describe_variable on one gives the recipe)
variants.title: Variants
